lines.it: Ma Alfie ce la fa appena con otto. Tu cosa suggeriresti?
lines.de: Aber Alfie schafft gerade mal acht. Was würdest du vorschlagen?

choices.en: I'd suggest drawing two: one with eight, one with ten.
choices.sl: {m:Predlagal|f:Predlagala} bi, da narišete dva: enega z osmimi, enega z desetimi.
choices.it: Suggerirei di disegnarne due: una con otto, una con dieci.
choices.de: Ich würde vorschlagen, zwei zu malen: eins mit acht, eins mit zehn.

reply.en: Two hopscotches! Why didn't I think of that?
reply.sl: Dva ristanca! Zakaj se tega nisem spomnila sama?
reply.it: Due campane! Perché non ci ho pensato io?
reply.de: Zwei Hüpfspiele! Warum bin ich nicht darauf gekommen?

choices.en: I'd suggest to draw two: one with eight, one with ten.
choices.sl: {m:Predlagal|f:Predlagala} bi, da narišete dva: enega z osmimi, enega z desetimi.
choices.it: Suggerirei di disegnarne due: una con otto, una con dieci.
choices.de: Ich würde vorschlagen, zwei zu malen: eins mit acht, eins mit zehn.

why.en: Suggest takes -ing: suggest drawing. To + the base form goes after decide, want, agree.
why.sl: Suggest zahteva -ing: suggest drawing. To z osnovno obliko gre za decide, want, agree.
why.it: Suggest vuole -ing: suggest drawing. To + la forma base va dopo decide, want, agree.
why.de: Suggest nimmt -ing: suggest drawing. To + Grundform steht nach decide, want, agree.

reply.en: Suggest to draw? Listen to how that sounds, {learner}.
reply.sl: Suggest to draw? Prisluhni, kako to zveni.
reply.it: Suggest to draw? Ascolta come suona, {learner}.
reply.de: Suggest to draw? Hör mal, wie das klingt, {learner}.

lines.en: Lovely. And the chalk will last till it rains.
lines.sl: Lepo. In kreda bo zdržala, dokler ne bo dežja.
lines.it: Bene. E il gesso durerà finché non piove.
lines.de: Schön. Und die Kreide hält, bis es regnet.

choices.en: It won't rain today, will it?

reply.en: Not a cloud. Mind you, this is Cumbria.
reply.sl: Niti oblačka. No, to je pač Cumbria.
reply.it: Neanche una nuvola. Però siamo in Cumbria.
reply.de: Keine Wolke. Aber gut, das ist Cumbria.

choices.en: It won't rain today, won't it?

why.en: A no sentence gets a yes tag: it won't rain, will it?
why.sl: Nikalni stavek dobi trdilno vprašanje: it won't rain, will it?
why.it: Una frase negativa vuole una coda positiva: it won't rain, will it?
why.de: Ein verneinter Satz bekommt eine bejahte Frage: it won't rain, will it?

reply.en: Won't it, won't it? Now I'm not sure what you're asking!
reply.sl: Won't it, won't it? Zdaj pa ne vem, kaj sprašuješ!
reply.it: Won't it, won't it? Adesso non so cosa mi chiedi!
reply.de: Won't it, won't it? Jetzt weiß ich nicht, was du fragst!

lines.en: Two hopscotches it is. Poppy will be thrilled, and Alfie too.
lines.sl: Torej dva ristanca. Poppy bo navdušena, Alfie tudi.
lines.it: Due campane, allora. Poppy sarà felicissima, e anche Alfie.
lines.de: Also zwei Hüpfspiele. Poppy wird begeistert sein, und Alfie auch.

memory.en: the bubble as big as your head
memory.sl: milni mehurček, velik kot tvoja glava
memory.it: la bolla grande come la tua testa
memory.de: die Seifenblase, so groß wie dein Kopf

lines.en: Good evening, {learner}. A warm evening and no wind: perfect for bubbles. I've got two mixtures here.
lines.sl: Dober večer, {learner}. Topel večer brez vetra: kot nalašč za mehurčke. Tu imam dve mešanici.
lines.it: Buonasera, {learner}. Una sera calda e senza vento: perfetta per le bolle. Ho qui due miscele.
lines.de: Guten Abend, {learner}. Ein warmer Abend ohne Wind: perfekt für Seifenblasen. Ich habe hier zwei Mischungen.

lines.en: Neither of them lasted long yesterday. Then Poppy put a spoonful of sugar in both.
lines.sl: Včeraj nobena ni dolgo zdržala. Potem je Poppy v obe dala žlico sladkorja.
lines.it: Ieri nessuna delle due durava molto. Poi Poppy ha messo un cucchiaio di zucchero in tutte e due.
lines.de: Gestern hat keine von beiden lange gehalten. Dann hat Poppy in beide einen Löffel Zucker getan.

lines.en: So, which one shall we use?
lines.sl: No, katero bova {m:uporabila|f:uporabili}?
lines.it: Allora, quale usiamo?
lines.de: Also, welche nehmen wir?

choices.en: Either will do now, since they've both got sugar in.
choices.sl: Zdaj je vseeno katera, ker imata obe sladkor.
choices.it: Adesso va bene l'una o l'altra, visto che hanno tutte e due lo zucchero.
choices.de: Jetzt passt jede, weil in beiden Zucker ist.

reply.en: Either. Good. Then you take one, and I'll take the other.
reply.sl: Katerakoli. Dobro. Potem vzameš eno ti, drugo jaz.
reply.it: L'una o l'altra. Bene. Allora tu ne prendi una e io l'altra.
reply.de: Egal welche. Gut. Dann nimmst du die eine und ich die andere.

choices.en: Only the second one, since the first has no sugar.
choices.sl: Samo drugo, ker prva nima sladkorja.
choices.it: Solo la seconda, visto che la prima non ha zucchero.
choices.de: Nur die zweite, weil in der ersten kein Zucker ist.

why.en: Poppy put sugar in both: so either of them will do now.
why.sl: Poppy je dala sladkor v obe: zato je zdaj vseeno katera.
why.it: Poppy ha messo lo zucchero in tutte e due: ora va bene l'una o l'altra.
why.de: Poppy hat in beide Zucker getan: Jetzt passt also jede.

reply.en: No sugar? Poppy put a spoonful in each!
reply.sl: Brez sladkorja? Poppy je dala žlico v vsako!
reply.it: Senza zucchero? Poppy ne ha messo un cucchiaio in ciascuna!
reply.de: Kein Zucker? Poppy hat in jede einen Löffel getan!

lines.en: You don't really like bubbles, do you?
lines.sl: Mehurčki ti v resnici niso všeč, kajne?
lines.it: Le bolle in fondo non ti piacciono, vero?
lines.de: Seifenblasen magst du eigentlich nicht, oder?

choices.en: I do like them! I just can't blow big ones.
choices.sl: Seveda so mi všeč! Samo velikih ne znam pihati.
choices.it: Sì che mi piacciono! Solo che non so soffiarle grandi.
choices.de: Doch, ich mag sie! Ich kann nur keine großen pusten.

reply.en: Then let me show you. Slowly, like a whisper.
reply.sl: Potem ti pokažem. Počasi, kot šepet.
reply.it: Allora ti faccio vedere. Piano, come un sussurro.
reply.de: Dann zeig ich's dir. Langsam, wie ein Flüstern.

choices.en: I do likes them! I just can't blow big ones.
choices.sl: Seveda so mi všeč! Samo velikih ne znam pihati.
choices.it: Sì che mi piacciono! Solo che non so soffiarle grandi.
choices.de: Doch, ich mag sie! Ich kann nur keine großen pusten.

why.en: Do + the base form, the same for every person: I do like them.
why.sl: Do + osnovna oblika, enaka za vse osebe: I do like them.
why.it: Do + la forma base, uguale per tutte le persone: I do like them.
why.de: Do + Grundform, für jede Person gleich: I do like them.

reply.en: Do likes? That's a new one for my list!
reply.sl: Do likes? Tega pa še nimam na svojem seznamu!
reply.it: Do likes? Questa è nuova per la mia lista!
reply.de: Do likes? Das ist neu für meine Liste!

lines.en: There! A bubble as big as your head. A gentle breath makes a big bubble.
lines.sl: Tako! Mehurček, velik kot tvoja glava. Nežen dih naredi velik mehurček.
lines.it: Ecco! Una bolla grande come la tua testa. Un soffio leggero fa una bolla grande.
lines.de: Da! Eine Blase so groß wie dein Kopf. Ein sanfter Atem macht eine große Blase.

memory.en: the polite letter about the children's coats
memory.it: la lettera gentile sui cappotti dei bambini
memory.de: den höflichen Brief wegen der Kindermäntel

lines.en: Good morning, {learner}. The hopscotch is done. Now a harder job: a letter to the parents about coats.
lines.sl: Dobro jutro, {learner}. Ristanc je narisan. Zdaj pa težje delo: pismo staršem o plaščih.
lines.it: Buongiorno, {learner}. La campana è pronta. Ora un lavoro più difficile: una lettera ai genitori sui cappotti.
lines.de: Guten Morgen, {learner}. Das Hüpfspiel ist fertig. Jetzt eine schwerere Aufgabe: ein Brief an die Eltern wegen der Mäntel.

lines.en: Half the children came out yesterday without one. How do I ask the parents, politely?
lines.sl: Včeraj je pol otrok prišlo ven brez njega. Kako naj vljudno prosim starše?
lines.it: Ieri metà dei bambini è uscita senza. Come lo chiedo ai genitori, con garbo?
lines.de: Gestern kam die Hälfte der Kinder ohne raus. Wie bitte ich die Eltern höflich darum?

choices.en: I would be grateful if you could send your child with a coat.
choices.sl: Hvaležna bi bila, če bi otroka poslali s plaščem.
choices.it: Le sarei grata se potesse mandare suo figlio con un cappotto.
choices.de: Ich wäre Ihnen dankbar, wenn Sie Ihr Kind mit einem Mantel schicken könnten.

reply.en: Perfect. Grateful and could: they'll read every word.
reply.sl: Popolno. Grateful in could: prebrali bodo vsako besedo.
reply.it: Perfetto. Grateful e could: leggeranno ogni parola.
reply.de: Perfekt. Grateful und could: Das lesen sie Wort für Wort.

choices.en: Send your kid with a coat, yeah?
choices.it: Mandate il bambino col cappotto, eh?
choices.de: Schickt euer Kind mit Mantel, ja?

why.en: A letter to parents is formal: I would be grateful if you could … . Yeah? and kid are for friends.
why.sl: Pismo staršem je uradno: I would be grateful if you could … . Yeah? in kid sta za prijatelje.
why.it: Una lettera ai genitori è formale: I would be grateful if you could … . Yeah? e kid sono per gli amici.
why.de: Ein Brief an Eltern ist förmlich: I would be grateful if you could … . Yeah? und kid sind für Freunde.

reply.en: Yeah? To the parents? They'd think I'd gone daft!
reply.sl: Yeah? Staršem? Mislili bi, da se mi je zmešalo!
reply.it: Yeah? Ai genitori? Penserebbero che sono impazzita!
reply.de: Yeah? An die Eltern? Die würden denken, ich spinne!

lines.en: And then the reason. Playing in the cold without a coat is… not comfortable. What's the one word?
lines.sl: Potem pa razlog. Igrati se na mrazu brez plašča je … ni udobno. Kako se reče z eno besedo?
lines.it: E poi il motivo. Giocare al freddo senza cappotto è… non comodo. Qual è la parola giusta?
lines.de: Und dann der Grund. Ohne Mantel in der Kälte spielen ist … nicht bequem. Wie heißt das in einem Wort?

reply.en: Uncomfortable. Now I sound like a proper teacher!
reply.sl: Uncomfortable. Zdaj zvenim kot prava učiteljica!
reply.it: Uncomfortable. Adesso sembro una vera maestra!
reply.de: Uncomfortable. Jetzt klinge ich wie eine richtige Lehrerin!

why.en: Comfortable takes un-: uncomfortable. Dis- goes with agree and like: disagree, dislike.
why.sl: Comfortable dobi un-: uncomfortable. Dis- gre z agree in like: disagree, dislike.
why.it: Comfortable prende un-: uncomfortable. Dis- va con agree e like: disagree, dislike.
why.de: Comfortable bekommt un-: uncomfortable. Dis- passt zu agree und like: disagree, dislike.

reply.en: Discomfortable? There's discomfort, but that one's new to me.
reply.sl: Discomfortable? Discomfort obstaja, tega pa ne poznam.
reply.it: Discomfortable? Esiste discomfort, ma questa non la conosco.
reply.de: Discomfortable? Discomfort gibt es, aber das kenn ich nicht.

lines.en: There. Signed, sealed, and in every bag by home time. Thank you, {learner}.
lines.sl: Tako. Podpisano, zaprto in do konca pouka v vsaki torbi. Hvala, {learner}.
lines.it: Ecco. Firmata, chiusa e in ogni cartella prima dell'uscita. Grazie, {learner}.
lines.de: So. Unterschrieben, zugeklebt und bis Schulschluss in jeder Tasche. Danke, {learner}.

memory.en: the wand Harry made out of a coat hanger
memory.sl: čarobno palico, ki jo je Harry naredil iz obešalnika
memory.it: la bacchetta che Harry ha fatto con una gruccia
memory.de: den Pustering, den Harry aus einem Kleiderbügel gebaut hat

lines.en: Good evening, {learner}. Shall we blow some bubbles? Harry made this wand out of a coat hanger.
lines.sl: Dober večer, {learner}. Bova pihala mehurčke? Harry je to palico naredil iz obešalnika.
lines.it: Buonasera, {learner}. Facciamo le bolle? Harry ha fatto questa bacchetta con una gruccia.
lines.de: Guten Abend, {learner}. Wollen wir Seifenblasen pusten? Harry hat diesen Ring aus einem Kleiderbügel gebaut.

lines.en: He said something funny about it this morning. Did you hear?
lines.sl: Zjutraj je o njej rekel nekaj smešnega. Si {m:slišal|f:slišala}?
lines.it: Stamattina ha detto una cosa buffa. L'hai sentita?
lines.de: Heute Morgen hat er was Lustiges darüber gesagt. Hast du's gehört?

choices.en: He said it was the biggest wand in Cumbria.
choices.sl: Rekel je, da je to največja palica v Cumbrii.
choices.it: Ha detto che era la bacchetta più grande della Cumbria.
choices.de: Er hat gesagt, es sei der größte Ring in ganz Cumbria.

reply.en: In Cumbria! He doesn't do small, our Harry.
reply.sl: V Cumbrii! Naš Harry ne pozna majhnega.
reply.it: Della Cumbria! Il nostro Harry non fa niente in piccolo.
reply.de: In ganz Cumbria! Klein kann er nicht, unser Harry.

choices.en: He told it was the biggest wand in Cumbria.
choices.sl: Rekel je, da je to največja palica v Cumbrii.
choices.it: Ha detto che era la bacchetta più grande della Cumbria.
choices.de: Er hat gesagt, es sei der größte Ring in ganz Cumbria.

why.en: Tell needs a person: he told me it was … . Without one, say: he said it was …
why.sl: Tell potrebuje osebo: he told me it was … . Brez nje reci: he said it was …
why.it: Tell vuole una persona: he told me it was … . Senza, di': he said it was …
why.de: Tell braucht eine Person: he told me it was … . Ohne sie sag: he said it was …

reply.en: Told who? Told the whole playground, probably.
reply.sl: Told komu? Najbrž celemu igrišču.
reply.it: Told a chi? A tutto il cortile, probabilmente.
reply.de: Told wem? Wahrscheinlich dem ganzen Spielplatz.

lines.en: I've been blowing bubbles since I was three.
lines.sl: Mehurčke piham, odkar sem imela tri leta.
lines.it: Faccio le bolle da quando avevo tre anni.
lines.de: Ich puste Seifenblasen, seit ich drei war.

lines.en: And you? When did you last do this?
lines.sl: Pa ti? Kdaj si to nazadnje {m:počel|f:počela}?
lines.it: E tu? Quand'è l'ultima volta che l'hai fatto?
lines.de: Und du? Wann hast du das zuletzt gemacht?

choices.en: I haven't blown bubbles since I was a child.
choices.it: Non faccio le bolle da quando ero {m:bambino|f:bambina}.
choices.de: Ich habe seit meiner Kindheit keine Seifenblasen mehr gepustet.

reply.en: Then you've got some catching up to do. Here, take the wand.
reply.sl: Potem moraš marsikaj nadoknaditi. Na, vzemi palico.
reply.it: Allora hai un po' da recuperare. Tieni, prendi la bacchetta.
reply.de: Dann hast du einiges nachzuholen. Hier, nimm den Ring.

choices.en: I haven't blown bubbles for I was a child.
choices.it: Non faccio le bolle da quando ero {m:bambino|f:bambina}.
choices.de: Ich habe seit meiner Kindheit keine Seifenblasen mehr gepustet.

why.en: Since + when it began, a time or a clause: since I was a child. For + how long: for years.
why.sl: Since + kdaj se je začelo, čas ali stavek: since I was a child. For + kako dolgo: for years.
why.it: Since + quando è cominciato, un momento o una frase: since I was a child. For + quanto dura: for years.
why.de: Since + wann es anfing, eine Zeit oder ein Satz: since I was a child. For + wie lange: for years.

reply.en: For I was a child? You've lost me there, {learner}.
reply.sl: For I was a child? Zdaj si me pa {m:zmedel|f:zmedla}.
reply.it: For I was a child? Qui mi sono persa, {learner}.
reply.de: For I was a child? Da komm ich nicht mit, {learner}.

lines.en: Gently, now… Look at that one, all the colours of the rainbow!
lines.sl: Nežno … Poglej tega, v vseh mavričnih barvah!
lines.it: Piano… Guarda quella, con tutti i colori dell'arcobaleno!
lines.de: Sachte … Schau dir die an, in allen Regenbogenfarben!
